'''Evan Clemens My Take On Harvestrom''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Evan Clemens]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-1569">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1569 My Take On Harvestrom], DeckTech (Evan "fizz247" Clemens, 6 December 1999). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/1569/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/1569/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018221231/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/1569/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Evan Clemens]]
* '''Published:''' 6 December 1999 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''My Take On Harvestrom''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning|Endor-L-carefulplanning.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PEndor MTOH Clemens LS 1999 DeckTech.txt |Download]]
* '''Strategy:''' Basically uses maelstom engine, despite errata.  It cycles through your deck to get all the heavy hitters in 2-3 turns, Frozen Assets+Draw Their Fire to kill them in one big battle.

== Original post ==

'''My Take On Harvestrom'''
* '''Author:''' Evan "fizz247" Clemens
* '''Published:''' December 6, 1999
* '''Rating:''' 4.0
* '''Description:''' Basically uses maelstom engine, despite errata.  It cycles through your deck to get all the heavy hitters in 2-3 turns, Frozen Assets+Draw Their Fire to kill them in one big battle.

=== Strategy ===

You know, basic maelsrom strategy.	Use spaceport speeders w/ desent into the dark and HDWGITM to get all the cards you need for a beatdown of your opponent.  Really abusive, but effective despite errata.  Don't forget to shake hands.
